Gorilla_Massive_Fists.description: Enormous, knuckle-dragging fists covered in thick, knotted muscles and coarse black hair, capable of delivering bone-crushing blows and reducing armor to mere scrap metal, these fearsome appendages are the hallmark of a gorilla's formidable strength and resilience.

Chimpanzee_Nimble_Arms.description: Fitted with sinewy, elongated limbs that grant unparalleled dexterity and agility, the Chimpanzee_Nimble_Arms enable their bearer to traverse treacherous environments with ease, whether it's scaling sheer cliffs or swinging from tree to tree, while also enhancing their sleight of hand and the mystical ability to spider climb.

Gibbon_Long_Brachiating_Arms.description: Equipped with these long, sinewy arms, the primate's lithe form is transformed into a natural arboreal acrobat, granting unparalleled agility and reach as it swings and climbs with effortless grace, its limbs perfectly adapted for the dance of the canopy.

Baboon_Muscular_Forelimbs.description: Brawny and sinewy, the baboon's muscular forelimbs bulge with powerful tendons and rippling muscles, enhancing both its raw strength and nimbleness, making it a formidable climber and a relentless fighter in close quarters.

Lemur_Grabbing_Paws.description: Equipped with elongated, prehensile limbs, the Lemur Grabbing Paws are a marvel of primate engineering, allowing for effortless navigation through the dense canopy and enabling a swift, almost supernatural grasp that enhances agility and dexterity.

Spectral_Ape_Ghostly_Arms.description: Emerging from the mist, the Spectral Ape's ghostly arms stretch unnaturally long, their translucent fingers shimmering with arcane energy, granting them a formidable reach and an eerie ability to hover and detect magic, their touch capable of delivering devastating magical attacks.

Zombie_Gorilla_Crushing_Fists.description: These massive, rotting fists are fused with the sheer strength and resilience of a primal beast, their gnarled knuckles and thick, pulsating veins hinting at a terrifying might that can shatter bones and crush steel with ease.

Orangutan_Long_Hairy_Arms.description: Brimming with primal wisdom and untamed strength, the Orangutan's long, sinewy arms are a marvel of evolutionary adaptation, granting them unparalleled reach and agility to swing effortlessly through the dense canopy, where they can grapple foes with bone-crushing force or traverse treacherous heights with ease.

Silverback_Armored_Forearms.description: Enveloped in a layer of hardened silver scales, the Silverback Armored Forearms are a testament to brute strength and resilience, granting their wielder an impenetrable shield and the ability to withstand the most relentless attacks, while also enhancing their grip and climbing prowess in the densest of forests.

Marmoset_Tiny_Clawed_Hands.description: Tiny yet formidable, these clawed hands are adapted for swift and silent movements, granting their primate bearer unparalleled dexterity and agility, enabling them to traverse treacherous terrain with ease and execute quick, precise actions.
